newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Nafin says capitalization level 11.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Nafin says capitalization level 11.8 pct.

text.p: State development bank Nacional Financiera, firmly denying a news report that it had declared bankruptcy, said on Monday that its capitalization level at the end of the third quarter was 11.8 percent.
"That is above the level required by the authorities for Mexican development banks," a press official, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters.

"Nafin is not bankrupt and it never declared it was," the official added, noting that, as an institution backed by the federal government, it would be illogical for the authorities to let it go bankrupt.

On Monday, Mexico's private Finsat news agency withdrew a report saying Nafin declared itself bankrupt, explaining that it had inaccurately reported the opinions of an economist as fact. Finsat is run by the Mexican newspaper El Financiero.
